does_not_establish: that generated fixture projects are editorially publishable

current_authorization.reason: Schema-realistic 1k and 10k fixtures pass the shard budgets, the guarded hierarchical prefix-migration candidate is bounded, and DE/EN paginated recovery plus canonical project pages now pass deterministic 1k/10k budgets. Visible scale-native runtime search, map and digital navigation, remaining failure/device parity, deployed production readback and physical-device surfaces remain unproven.

decision_policy.rollback: Restore the previous fixture generator and evidence while retaining the compact build-bound bootstrap and complete generated recovery catalogue before reattempting cutover.
decision_policy.stress_boundary: The representative 100,000-entry compact stress tier is a measured hard failure for fixed two-hex shards, not a production-ready scale claim.
decision_policy.prefix_migration_candidate: Three-hex SHA-256 partitions may be implemented only together with a versioned hierarchical manifest and aggregate contract, compatibility tests, bounded recovery and exact-head browser evidence.
